source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5.2 (PDF 218-219), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Investment (sarmayakari) ka matlab hai kisi karobar ya project mein is maqsad se paisa lagana ke aage chal kar profit mile.
Misal: agar Islamabad ki kapron ki dukaan naye maal (inventory) par Rs. 50,000 lagati hai, to use umeed hai ke yeh maal laagat se zyada qeemat par bikega aur profit hoga.

Savings (bachat) ka matlab hai mustaqbil ki zarooraton ke liye paisa alag rakhna. Karobar apne profit ka kuch hissa bachata hai ta ke naya saaman (equipment) khareede, karobar barhaye ya achanak aane wale kharche sambhale. Maslan Peshawar ka ek chhota restaurant har mahine Rs. 10,000 alag rakh sakta hai ta ke ek saal mein naye oven ke liye kafi paisa jama ho jaye (10,000 × 12 = Rs. 120,000).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yeh raqam "Rs. 10.000" (comma ki jagah full stop ke saath) chhapi hai. Sahi raqam Rs. 10,000 (das hazaar rupay) mahana hai; "10.000" parh kar das rupay na samjhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Pakistan mein bohat se log paisa bachane ke liye sone (gold) mein investment karte hain. Sone ko mehfooz investment samjha jata hai kyunke aam taur par waqt ke saath is ki qeemat barhti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Sone ki qeemat aam taur par barhti hai magar kabhi kabhi gir bhi sakti hai. Kitab yahan sirf Pakistan ka ek aam riwaj bata rahi hai, koi mashwara nahi de rahi.

blocks.prompt: Karobar ke liye ek zaroori financial concept bayan kijiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Profit: revenue mein se tamam kharche nikalne ke baad bachne wala paisa. Is se pata chalta hai ke karobar waqai paisa kama raha hai ya nahi, aur is ka ek hissa bachaya (savings) ya dobara karobar mein lagaya (investment) ja sakta hai.

items: Investment: aaj paisa laga kar baad mein profit.
Savings: mustaqbil ke liye paisa alag rakhna (Rs. 10,000 × 12 = Rs. 120,000).
